definitions.classification: NDVI at or above the frozen threshold is likely vegetated; Urban Atlas arable land and water are excluded from display but retained in the denominator.

source.attribution: Derived using European Union Copernicus Sentinel-2 information.

calibrationSource.caveat: Urban Atlas represents 2021 while the NDVI observation is from 2023. Changed areas and polygon generalisation can contaminate calibration.

processing.subpixelSampling: 3 x 3; calibration requires at least 8 of 9 samples in one reference class.
processing.areaCalculation: 10 m pixels split into 3 x 3 samples in EPSG:32631 and normalised to full projected sector area.
